note: One entry per gathered raw sheet. `grid` is [cols, rows]; `cuts` is the panel order, left to right then top to bottom. `mode` single means one panel, nothing to split. `master` names ship as the whole sheet. `plan_from` records where the layout came from; `superseded` records a panel renamed because another sheet owns the plain name. Panels are cut at their boundaries only: no background keying, no trimming.
